/**********************************************************************************************************************
 * Artist: FEZ
 * Date: 02.05.2024
 * Title: S!mpl!f! (#WCCChallenge - Simplify)
 *
 * Simplification is a pattern often used in communication and political discourse. Some politicians are known for
 * over-simplifying just about everything. And that's what this sketch is about
 *
 * It takes sentences from the news that contain the words "too complex" or "high complexity" and shows their
 * simplified versions:
 * - version 0 is the original text
 * - version 1 being technically simplyfied as done in natutal language analysis
 * - version 2 taking the sentiment of the original text and its least frequently used word, combining those into a 
 *               short sentence as it would be used by some populist politicans
 *
 * The texts that rendered in this sketch (see tab "sentences") were created with a python script which you can
 * find in my accompanying github repository: https://github.com/fezde/wccchallenge/blob/main/02_simplify.py
 *
 * A big shoutout to (some "as usual"):
 *  - all participants of the challenge
 *  - the creators and conrtibutors of p5js and openprocessing - without you, creativity would be different today
 *  - Raphaël for the challenge
 *
 *
 * This sketch was created for Sableraph's weekly creative coding challenges, 
 * reviewed Sundays on https://www.twitch.tv/sableraph
 * Also join The Birb's Nest Discord community! https://discord.gg/S8c7qcjw2b
 *
 *
 * Regarding all copyrights for the used materials, see 
 * - the code that generated the data: https://github.com/fezde/wccchallenge/blob/main/02_simplify.py
 * - and the readme.md of the github project: https://github.com/fezde/wccchallenge
 * 
 ***********************************************************************************************************************/

sentence = {}

fontSize = 30
textBorder = 20

let stage = 0
let stageStart = 0
let stageTimeout = 500

function setup() {
	createCanvas(1024, 1024)
	background(255)
	mousePressed()
}

function drawBackground() {
	textSize(fontSize * 4)

	textFont("sans-serif")
	textStyle(BOLD)
	textLeading(fontSize * 3)
	textAlign(CENTER, CENTER)

	if (stage > 0) {
		fill(240)
		text(
			sentence.original,
			textBorder, textBorder,
			width - 2 * textBorder, height - 2 * textBorder
		)
	}

	if (stage > 2) {
		fill(230)
		text(
			sentence.simplified,
			textBorder, textBorder,
			width - 2 * textBorder, height - 2 * textBorder
		)
	}
}

function drawForeground() {
	textSize(fontSize)
	textLeading(fontSize)
	fill(0)

	textAlign(CENTER, CENTER)
	textFont("monospace")
	textStyle(NORMAL)
	text(
		sentence.original,
		textBorder, textBorder,
		width / 2 - 2 * textBorder, height / 2 - 2 * textBorder
	)

	if (stage > 1) {

		textFont("Times New Roman")
		text(
			sentence.simplified,
			width / 2 + textBorder, 0,
			width / 2 - 2 * textBorder, height / 2 - 2 * textBorder
		)
	}

	if (stage > 3) {
		textSize(fontSize * 4)
		textLeading(fontSize * 3.7)
		textAlign(CENTER, TOP)
		textStyle(BOLD)
		stroke(0)
		strokeWeight(5)

		textFont("sans-serif")
		text(
			sentence.sentiment_sentence,
			2 * textBorder, height / 2,
			width - 4 * textBorder, height * 0.5 - 4 * textBorder
		)
	}

}

function draw() {
	clear()
	background(255)
	noStroke()

	drawBackground()
	drawForeground()

	textSize(10)
	textAlign(RIGHT, BOTTOM)
	noStroke()
	textStyle(NORMAL)
	text(
		"FEZ",
		0, 0,
		width - 1 * textBorder, height - 1 * textBorder
	)
	updateStage()
}

function updateStage() {
	const duration = millis() - stageStart
	if (duration > stageTimeout) {
		stage++
		stageStart = millis()
		stageTimeout = random(234, 789)
	}
}

function mousePressed() {
	stage = 0
	stageStart = millis()
	sentence = random(sentences)
}

function keyPressed() {
	save()
}
